$comment: The one set of project root fixtures (#63). Both toolchains read this file: agent/internal/httpapi/roots_fixtures_test.go and packages/schema/src/roots-fixtures.test.ts. Never copy it per language. lists are RootList answers (GET and DELETE /api/roots), requests are RootRequest bodies (POST and DELETE), authorized are AuthorizedRoot answers (POST), errors are RootsError answers; each side checks them against the authoritative JSON Schema and against what it was generated into.

valid.name: available-and-unavailable
valid.why: An available root, and stored roots that failed the startup check, each with its reason.

valid.name: no-roots
valid.why: Nothing authorized yet, which is how the agent starts the first time.

invalid.name: no-roots-property
invalid.why: roots is required, even when it is empty.

invalid.name: root-without-availability
invalid.why: Every root says whether it is available.

invalid.name: unknown-reason
invalid.why: The reasons are a closed set.

invalid.name: empty-path
invalid.why: A root always has a path.

invalid.name: extra-property
invalid.why: Nothing else rides along with a root, such as how it was spelled.

valid.name: a-path
valid.why: The one shape a POST or DELETE body has.

invalid.name: unknown-field
invalid.why: A request carries path and nothing else.

valid.name: the-real-path
valid.why: POST answers the real path that was authorized.

invalid.name: no-path
invalid.why: The answer always names what was authorized.

invalid.name: extra-property
invalid.why: The answer is the path and nothing more.

valid.name: forbidden
valid.why: A path outside the home directory: a kind and a fixed sentence, and nothing about what is there.

body.message: only a directory inside the home directory can be a project directory

valid.name: too-broad
valid.why: The home directory, above it, or /.

body.message: the home directory, the directories above it and the filesystem root are too broad to be a project directory

valid.name: overlaps
valid.why: The one error that names something: the stored root the request overlaps.

body.message: this directory is inside, or contains, a project directory that is already authorized

invalid.name: unknown-kind
invalid.why: The kinds are a closed set.

invalid.name: a-resolved-path
invalid.why: Nothing from the underlying error is ever passed on.

body.message: only a directory inside the home directory can be a project directory
